title: Pickle Lantern Spirit
description: A monstrous anthropomorphic green pickle with a cherry on top, glowing red eyes, and a wide toothy grin emerges from swirling green ethereal energy and stylized blue waves. An old rusty lantern with a green flame floats to its left, set against a broken glass-like background revealing a dramatic sunset sky.
prompt: A grotesque yet charismatic anthropomorphic pickle creature with bumpy green skin, glowing red eyes, wide grinning mouth full of teeth, and a shiny red cherry with stem on its head. It emerges from swirling luminous green smoke and stylized blue ocean waves. A vintage metal lantern with a bright green flame floats beside it. The background shows a shattered glass portal revealing a dramatic sunset sky with pink and orange clouds, dark stone ruins covered in moss and skulls at the bottom, in a highly detailed dark fantasy style.
